versions.content: Sending SwComponentType owns a DataPrototypeGroup in the role dpgRequiresCoherency If a sending SwComponentType owns a DataPrototypeGroup in the role dpgRequiresCoherency for one or several of its RunnableEntity s it is required that VariableDataPrototype s belonging to the same DataPrototypeGroup are propagated at the same point of time to RunnableEntity s which do not belong to the group of producing RunnableEn- tity s (which may, but don't have to be formally described as a RunnableEntity- Group ).
